annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – The Protection of Youth and Minors in the Digital Sphere
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – The Protection of Youth and Minors in the Digital Sphere
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Committee of the Regions (rapporteur Heike Raab)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Committee of the Regions opinion on protecting minors in the digital sphere. It urges stronger platform accountability, enforcement of the DSA and AVMSD, safety-by-design, age verification, child rights impact assessments, media literacy, and a role for local and regional authorities. It mentions generative AI risks only briefly.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for consistent enforcement of DSA Articles 28 and 34 against very large platforms
Considers a minimum social media age of 14 with age-appropriate design to 16, with mandatory age verification
Calls for mandatory child rights impact assessments and bans on dark patterns and loot boxes
Welcomes a common EU age verification app, complementary to national systems
Stresses media literacy and a role for local and regional authorities
